title: PPG-WIRE-MS5 — Okuma OSP-P*M mill master post + tribal mining
description: Closes the Okuma OSP-P*M mill gap left open after PPG-WIRE-MS0. The master_post_by_machine auto-router previously HARD-REJECTed OSP-P300M / OSP-P500M models because no Okuma-mill master post engine existed. MS5 ships the engine + dispatcher wiring + (separate sub-unit) tribal-knowledge mining from JM Die's archive.
rationale: PPG-WIRE-MS0 wired the three highest-volume JM Die machine families (Hurco V11 mill, Okuma B250 lathe, Mitsubishi MV1200R wire EDM). The Okuma OSP-P*M mill controllers (used on Okuma MB-V series and MU-V 5-axis mills) were the only branch that failed to route — every other machine family now flows through the sealed-sidecar contract established by U-PPGM07..M15. MS5 closes that gap so OSP-P300M / OSP-P500M can emit, seal, and verify alongside the rest.
leverage_existing: ControllerDialectEngine — full OSP-P300/P500 mill dialect already authored (G15 H1 work offsets, G81/G83/G84/G85 canned cycles, G65 P88xx Renishaw probing, G05.1 Q1 Super-NURBS on P500, IJK incremental arcs, M98/M99 subprograms)
HurcoV11MillMasterPostEngine — canonical mill master post template; same MillOperation shape, BlockAnnotation flow, Kienzle/Taylor physics gate
sealMasterPostOutput (cps/sealMasterPostOutput.ts) — U-PPGM15 dispatcher-side helper that bridges engine output → sealed sidecar → optional tier gate
verifyBlockAnnotations (cps/verifyBlockAnnotations.ts) — tier-aware S/F gate; works unchanged on N100-style labels matching the new engine's spindle-start emission
PostPhysicsSidecar schema 1.1.0 — block_annotations[] field already shipped under U-PPGM07+08; new engine populates it from line 1

shipped.title: OkumaOSPMillMasterPostEngine + dispatcher wiring + HARD-REJECT replacement
shipped.summary: Builds OkumaOSPMillMasterPostEngine consuming ControllerDialectEngine OSP-P300/P500 mill dialect; family flag selects 3-axis (P300M / MB-V) vs 5-axis (P500M / MU-V); BlockAnnotation flow + Kienzle physics gate matches HurcoV11. Wires master_post_okuma_osp action through sealMasterPostOutput. Replaces the OSP-P*M HARD-REJECT branch in master_post_by_machine with router-side family inference.
shipped.tests: 45 unit cases + 12 sidecar integration cases (engine specific) + 6 mirror-route cases flipped from HARD-REJECT → engine-route assertions; 217/217 across 9 PPG-related suites including 156/156 across 4 master_post integration suites. Zero regression.
notes: Tribal mining intentionally deferred to U-PPGW-OkumaMill-Tribal — JM Die archive has no Okuma-mill source programs (Multus = mill-turn, mill side is Haas).

Engine ships with a small inline tribal pool (~6 tips: G15 H1 vs G54, [super_nurbs_hint] for P500, G65 P88xx probing IDs, T{n}+M6 two-line tool change, G94 feed/min stickiness, ISO-H/N material guidance).
Spindle ceiling: 12000 RPM (P300, MB-V default) / 15000 RPM (P500, MU-V default); configurable via max_spindle_rpm.
P500 only: G05.1 Q1 Super-NURBS bracket emitted when use_super_nurbs=true; G05.1 Q0 cancel on program end.

shipped.title: JM Die tribal expansion + JM_DIE_PRESET config
shipped.summary: Mines two authoritative posts from the JM Die archive — hyperMILL `OSPM_MT_TabAC_MUx_R01w_E03.def` (2023) and PRISM-modified Fusion 360 `OKUMA-M460V-5AX-Ai Enhanced-(iMachining).cps` (v8.9.x). Adds 14 new tribal tips (8→22 total) with .def/.cps file:line citations. Adds 4 optional config knobs (`tool_length_comp_mode`, `super_nurbs_code`, `tcp_mode`, `n_number_pad_digits`) all defaulting to current behavior. Exports `JM_DIE_PRESET: Partial<OkumaOSPMillPostConfig>` that flips them to JM Die canonical values: `G15 H15` work-offset, `G56 HA` tool-length comp, `G131 P1/P0` Super-NURBS (OSP-P300MA-H native), `G169/G170` TCP, `N0100` 4-digit zero-padded N-numbers.
shipped.tests: 13 new preset/tribal cases + 93 existing cases = 106/106 across 4 OkumaOSP suites. Defaults preserved verbatim: `G43 H{n}`, unpadded `N100`, `G05.1 Q1/Q0` all unchanged when preset NOT applied (regression block).
notes: Two source posts cross-validate: where they disagree (M51 = TSC vs chip-conveyor; A-axis +20 vs +10) the .cps wins (live in production, newer).
All 14 new tips carry `source: <file>:<line>` provenance so a shop-floor reader can grep back to the originating .def/.cps line.

Deferred to a future unit: CALL OO88 macro + fixture WCS 51 reservation, M206/M207 door codes, M50/M51 chip conveyor, spindle warm-up cycle, iMachining adaptive variable-feed emission, A-axis [-110,+10] range guard.

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Customer with an Okuma MB-V46 (OSP-P300M) loads a P20 mold cavity job — 4 ops: face mill, pocket rough, contour finish, drill grid.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_wire_ms5: POST /ppg/master/by-machine with machine_model='OSP-P300M' returns {success:false, error:'no Okuma mill master post engine exists yet'}. Customer falls back to manual G-code editing.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_wire_ms5: POST master_post_by_machine routes to OkumaOSPMillMasterPostEngine (family=P300 inferred from model string), emits 4 N-labelled spindle-start blocks each carrying matched block_annotations[], seals a v1.1.0 sidecar, optionally runs the verifier at shop_floor tier — same single-call contract as Hurco/B250.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: OSP-P*M is the last mill family in the PPG router that produced a HARD-REJECT. With U-PPGW-OkumaMill shipped, every supported machine model in master_post_by_machine returns the unified {engine_output, sidecar, verify?} shape.
